title: Workbench
subtitle: Third-party software and workflow platforms I rely on for learning, development, creative work, and knowledge capture.
viewAllDescription: Browse all software groups, toolchains, and workflow setups.

ai-assist.title: AI Assist Tools
ai-assist.summary: AI coding and assist workflows for understanding code, refactoring, review, and fast experiments.
points: Cursor Pro subscription
ChatGPT Pro 5x subscription
Minimax Plus fast-tier subscription
Copilot Pro Education subscription
Xiaomi MiMo Max creator incentive plan

Actively embrace the AI development era, spending hundreds of millions to billions of tokens each month while building practical experience with AI tools and solving the problems that appear in real work.
Mainly use Cursor for complex or research-heavy tasks that need continuous human steering and adjustment.
Mainly use Codex for coding tasks with clear goals and a well-understood implementation path.
Use QClaw and ChatGPT to remotely control the host machine from mobile devices and continue work away from the desk.
Use GitHub Copilot and Cursor Bugbot for PR review.

creative-adobe.title: Creative Software
creative-adobe.summary: The Adobe creative suite for image, video, audio, and multimedia production.
points: Covers retouching, vector, editing, motion, audio, and encoding workflows.
Creative Cloud leads the group as the subscription and asset sync entry point.
Supports long-running visual work such as posters and video.

office-productivity.title: Office & Productivity
office-productivity.summary: Microsoft 365, Lark, Acrobat, and WPS for documents and collaboration.
points: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, and OneNote for formal documents and sync.
Lark for team communication and some collaboration scenarios.
Acrobat for PDF; WPS as a cross-platform office supplement.

3d-software.title: 3D Software
3d-software.summary: Blender and Cinema 4D for 3D modeling, rendering, and spatial expression.
points: Blender for open-source 3D pipelines and concept work.
Cinema 4D for some commercial 3D and motion scenarios.
Works alongside the creative group for assets that need spatial expression.

analysis-tools.title: Analysis Tools
analysis-tools.summary: GPU profiling and network capture tools for debugging and performance work.
points: Nsight Compute and Nsight Systems for CUDA / GPU performance analysis.
Wireshark for network protocol and traffic inspection.
Used on demand when tuning systems or tracing issues.

dev-tools.title: Development Tools
dev-tools.summary: Editors and IDEs for everyday coding, debugging, and API collaboration.
points: VS Code as a lightweight general-purpose editor.
IDEA and PyCharm for Java and Python stacks respectively.
Apifox for API debugging and documentation; Xcode for Apple-platform development.

knowledge-tools.title: Knowledge Tools
knowledge-tools.summary: Note-taking and knowledge bases for capture, organization, references, and thinking.
points: Evernote and FlowUS for quick capture and structured notes.
Obsidian and Zotero for local knowledge graphs and references.
MindNow for mind maps and idea expansion; Typora for Markdown writing and layout.

virtual-remote.title: Virtual & Remote
virtual-remote.summary: Containers, VMs, terminals, and remote desktop tooling.
points: Docker for containerized development and deployment experiments.
Parallels Desktop to run Windows and other environments on macOS.
Termora as the terminal; Windows App for remote Windows hosts.
